spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python scripts/cross_split_eval.py --gpu_id 0"

experiment_data.hypothesis: 验证 8-seed router checkpoints 在独立 split（非训练 split）上的 balanced_acc 是否与 corrected_eval（55.7±5.0%）一致（Δ<2pp），确认 ga=8 训练 split-robust、论文数字可靠。
experiment_data.notes: Cross-split NOT robust (Δ=-7.0pp > 2pp threshold). Episode-level split (sklearn seed=42, 10 val episodes, 300 samples, 80%/20% det/int) gives mean=47.1±2.2% vs corrected_eval step-level split 54.1±5.4%. Cross-split std much lower (2.2pp vs 5.4pp) suggesting episode composition dominates variance. Per-seed deltas range from -0.6pp (seed43) to -16.3pp (seed49).
